hero.headline: The final operating system for high-performers.
hero.subcopy: Versions set the identity you're building. Cycles are the sprints inside them, aimed at the skills it takes. Track habits, goals, biometrics... The system analyzes the trends the eye misses.

heroImage.alt: El Portal dashboard — desktop closeup, spotlight matte

vcd.heading: Three horizons. One hierarchy.
vcd.subheading: Versions plan identity. Cycles run focus. Days carry the score.

captions.label: Version
captions.body: Identity arc. The phase you're committing to.

captions.label: Cycle
captions.body: Sprint on the skills that identity needs. Several fit inside a Version.

captions.label: Day
captions.body: Atomic unit. Weighted habits roll into one number.

mcpIntro.heading: Your agent keeps the record.
mcpIntro.body: Connect Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible agent. It reads habits, cycles, and trends. Writes back updates. The score moves while you do the work.
